description_sq: Ofrohet per shitje nje apartament 1+1 i cili eshte i pozicionuar ne katin e 3 banim te nje ndertimi te ri me ashensor te ndertuar rreth vitit 2011. Ka nje planimetri katrore te rregullt, dhe organizohet ne nje korridor i cili ben shperndarjen e ambjenteve ,nje soxhorno spacioze, nje dhome gjumi, nje ballkon dhe nje tualet. Ofrohet i mobiluar si ne foto. Prona disponon dokukentacion te rregullt hipotekor, mund te shitet dhe me financim bankar. Zona te ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme per nje jetese komode: shkolle, market, farmaci, aksesi me rrugen kryesore dhe stacionet urbane etj. Per me shume informacion ose nje vizite ne prone mos hezitoni te me kontaktoni.
description_en: A 1+1 apartment is offered for sale, which is located on the 3rd residential floor of a new building with an elevator built around 2011. It has a regular square layout, and is organized in a corridor that distributes the premises, a spacious living room, a bedroom, a balcony and a toilet. It is offered furnished as in the photo. The property has a regular mortgage documentation, it can be sold with bank financing. The area offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable life: school, market, pharmacy, access to the main road and urban stations, etc. For more information or a visit to the property, do not hesitate to contact me.
